{{Otheruses|Overseer}}
'''Overseer''' was a position within various governments and organizations that had the responsibilities of overseeing various projects or groups. [[Xun Garret]] served as Overseer of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tyed Kant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Then-[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Sander Delvardus]] lobbied to become the naval overseer of the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] under [[Grand Moff/Legends|Grand Moff]] [[Ardus Kaine]] for the [[Rimma Trade Route/Legends|Rimma Trade Route]], largely because he wanted to be stationed near [[Clak'dor VII/Legends|Clak'dor VII]], where his mistress, [[Seledra-Zin]], was staying.

The [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Juhm]] was the overseer of the [[Gwori shipyards]] at the time of the [[Battle of Gwori]]. The [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoan]] [[Umbrag]] was also an overseer in the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]].
